title: Gherkin: standup --rollup project|tree defaults and shapes
description:
## Intent
As a multi-project agent operator, I want `--rollup project` and `--rollup tree` with sensible defaults, so standup output matches congregation vs single-board context.

## Behavior
- `--rollup project`: one bullet per project, upward-summarized
- `--rollup tree`: nested project→epic→leaf
- Default: project at multi-project / congregation; tree OK inside single board

## DoD
Gherkin dual-runtime scenarios; no production code beyond failing specs in this story if specs-first split.
